steps.player: Hello. I would like to talk to the Sage if you don't mind?

steps.npc: You... Let me think. Yes, you have been granted permission to speak with the Sage.
But do not touch, nor think about attempting to release them. It will not go well for you.

steps.player: I wasn't planning on it. I can't reach up there anyway.

steps.npc: An answer for everything. Typical human.
You are far from many things in this place. Watch your tongue.

steps.player: I'm going to speak to the Sage now since you're intent on being rude.

steps.npc: I don't care what you do as long as you do not interfere. Proceed.
